text: I understand your frustration and the urgency of your situation. Since you're unable to provide the standard authentication methods (email or name + zip code) and need immediate assistance with your laptop exchange, I'll transfer you to a human agent who can help resolve this more directly.
zh: 我理解您的沮丧和情况的紧迫性。由于您无法提供标准的身份验证方法（邮箱或姓名+邮编），并且需要立即协助处理笔记本电脑换货，我会将您转接给一位可以更直接帮助您解决问题的客服人员。
